name: Navigation Acts
explanation: The Navigation Acts made it so that the colonies could only trade with Great Britain.
significance: This inhibited the colonies ability to be self sufficient.

name: Proclamation of 1763
explanation: The Proclamation of 1763 stopped any colonists from settling west of the Appalachian Mountains.
significance: This made the colonists unhappy because they wanted more land. Even more so this made the colonists unhappy because the Proclamation of 1763 ended the French and Indian War, a war that was expensive, they were being taxed for, and didn't even get more land from.

name: French and Indian War
explanation: The French and Indian War was the portion of the seven years war that occurred in North America.
significance: The colonists saw it as unnecessary and the taxes that followed even more so.

name: Pontiac's Rebellion
explanation: Pontiac's Rebellion was a rebellion by native americans against the british colonies.
significance: was started when some Native Americans who were not happy with Britain's control over the Ohio area following the French and Indian War, decided to fight back against the british, and more specifically their colonies.

name: Committees of Correspondence Created
explanation: The Committees of Correspondence were created by Thomas Jefferson to be able to communicate among the colonies.
significance: They Became very important during the early years of the American Revolution.

name: Writs of Assistance
explanation: The Writs of Assistance were search warrants that allowed the British government search anything including private homes.
significance: This made the colonists very unhappy to the point that they made sure to put an amendment in the constitution specifically about "The right of the people to be secure in their persons, houses, papers, and effects, against unreasonable searches and seizures, shall not be violated."

name: Stamp Act
explanation: The Stamp Act placed a tax on most printed goods.
significance: It was the first direct tax on the colonies.

name: Boston Massacre
explanation: The Boston Massacre occurred when British troops fired on colonists were protesting the taxes.
significance: It resulted in the Townshend Acts being repealed. It also made the colonists even more so se the British as hostile and untrustworthy.

name: Boston Tea Party
explanation: 150 colonists dump 340 chests of tea into the harbor to protest the Tea Act.
significance: It resulted in the intolerable acts being passed

name: Battles of Lexington and Concord
explanation: the Battles of Lexington and Concord where the first battles of the Revolutionary war
significance: They were before the Declaration of Independence had been signed.

name: Declaration of Independence
explanation: The Declaration of Independence was written by Thomas Jefferson with help from Franklin and John Adams.
significance: It declared the independence of the United States from Great britain and began the Revolutionary war. It contained a long list of complaints known as the "List of Grievances" and was influenced by enlightenment thinkers in Europe.

name: Sugar Act
explanation: The Sugar Act also known as the Revenue Act of 1764 placed taxes on imported goods like sugar.
significance: The colonists who tried to evade the sugar act were put on trial with out a jury

name: Coercive Acts and the Quebec Acts
explanation: Known as the Intolerable Acts to the colonists, they closed boston ports, reduced Massachusets Government, and it expanded the quartering act.
significance: It was punishment for the boston tea party.

name: Townshend Act
explanation: Taxed tea, glass, and paper and allowed British troops to search colonial homes.
significance: It would lead to the Boston Massacre which would end up repealing the Townshend Act.

name: Declaratory Act
explanation: The Declaratory Act made it so that the British could tax anything they want for any reason.
significance: It served no other purpose than as a show of dominance and for that reason made the colonists very unhappy.

name: Treaty of Paris 1783
explanation: The Treaty of Paris 1783 ended the American Revolution.
significance: It set Britain's borders with the states, and meant that Britain officially recognized the Untied States as a separate sovereign entity

name: 1st Continental Congress
explanation: Delegates form every colony, except Georgia, met to discuss the next course of action against the British
significance: Most of the Delegates at this point were not looking for full independence but just for Britain to be more fair.

name: 2nd Continental Congress
explanation: July 4, 1776, the 2nd Continental Congress submitted the Declaration of Independence to Great Britain declaring themselves independent.
significance: This started the revolution

name: Constitutional Convention
explanation: 55 delegates came together in Philadelphia with the goal of fixing the Articles of Confederation.
significance: They ended up creating the constitution and elected George Washington as president.

name: Articles of Confederation
explanation: The Continental Congress adopted the Articles of Confederation which established a weak central government
significance: The government could declare war, raise armies, sign treaties, and borrow money, but it could not collect taxes.

name: Washington's Administration
explanation: George Washington's time as president
significance: During which, he set many precedents, including having a cabinet and only serving 2 terms. He was incredibly popular and was the only president ever to win 100% of the popular vote.

name: Shays' Rebellion
explanation: Daniel Shays and some farmers lead an armed rebellion.
significance: It was caused because because Massachusets raised its taxes and they could no longer make their mortgage payments.

name: Whiskey Rebellion
explanation: Whiskey Rebellion was a protest, turned rebellion, against the 1791 "Whiskey Tax"
significance: It was put down by George Washington.

name: Adams' Administration
explanation: John Adams was the second president of the United States.
significance: His time as president lead to both the XYZ Affair and the Alien and Sedition Acts.

name: XYZ Affair
explanation: The XYZ Affair was a failed diplomatic commission in 1797
significance: It lead to a confrontation between the United States and France that led to the Quasi-War. The Quasi-War being a time of naval combat between the US and France that did not have a proper declaration of war.

name: Alien and Sedition Acts
explanation: The Alien and Sedition Acts made it more difficult for people to become citizens, allowed the president to imprison and deport non-citezens and made it a crime to speak out against the federal government.
significance: The Democratic-Republicans denounced The acts as suppression of voters and a violation of free speech according to the First Amendment.
